I added `DELETE /api/v1/items/{id}/description`. It sets the item's description to `None` and returns the updated item. Only the owner or a superuser can call it. Nothing was run, per your instruction.

- **`backend/app/api/routes/items.py`**: the new `clear_item_description` route returns `ItemPublic`. It returns 404 "Item not found" for a missing item and 403 "Not enough permissions" for a non-owner, the same as the other item routes.
- **`backend/app/crud.py`**: added `get_item` and `clear_item_description`. The docs say routes should reach the database only through `crud.py`, so the route calls these instead of the session directly.

The lint hook flagged integer status literals and a missing keyword-only `*` in my first version. I fixed both in the new code and didn't touch the existing routes.

I did not run `scripts/generate-client.sh`. The project docs ask for the client to be regenerated after endpoint changes, so the frontend client won't include this operation until someone runs it. I left the commit and push alone as well.
